item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a singleton coil array's member identifier be read from a per-source-group pattern declared in facility configuration, so JT-60SA's MMSYS currents (curEF5LKAT, curCS1HiTe, curUFPLKAT, cur1TFLKAT) resolve to EF5/CS1/UFP/1; imas_codex/ids/handoff.py:116-133 _member_identifier now takes an optional compiled member_pattern and returns its `member` named group, and build_mapping_handoff computes _member_patterns(facility) once at handoff.py:212 and passes the row's group pattern at handoff.py:322-324, which is exactly the goal.

justifications.evidence: the change's own gate passes at head (review-head-gate.log, 615 passed 5 skipped EXIT=0) and at base (review-base-gate.log, 607 passed 5 skipped EXIT=0), the negative control reddens three tests (logs/negative_control.log, 3 failed EXIT=1), and I independently recounted the artifact at 40/40 MMSYS non-null; the run recorded neither a baseline nor an after arm, and the evidence fragment attributes the re-export to the parent commit 0ea3c2c5c though the artifact predates the change commit.
justifications.fit: the pattern is declared per source group in the facility config schema and compiled in _member_patterns, the new parameter is optional so existing callers keep the old rule, and every comment names the mechanism rather than a plan identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/ids/handoff.py:116-133 reads the row's group pattern first and returns its `member` named group, and facility knowledge lives in configuration (imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml:212) rather than in an exporter guess, which is exactly what section 23 asks.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing _member_identifier and reuses the trailing-number fallback and get_facility, adding a configuration slot rather than a second identifier instrument.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 7fd829ac9^ 7fd829ac9 --name-status is exactly the five declared paths, touching no concurrent node's path and no other module.

The nine DCSV rows stay null because their names carry no trailing number and DCSV declares no pattern, which is the documented fallback and outside this node's done-when. Total 117, verdict pass.
